title: heteropappus biennis
intro: Heteropappus biennis, commonly known as Horse Mint, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Heteropappus biennis include its ability to act as a natural expectorant, relaxant, and anti-spasmodic, making it useful in treating respiratory issues, anxiety, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
